bridge-type.label: Bosch Smart Home Camera Account
bridge-type.description: A Bosch SingleKey ID account the cameras are registered with.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval the camera settings are polled from the Bosch cloud in sec. Only relevant for changes made outside of openHAB.

parameter.name: snapshotAllowedNetworks
parameter.label: Snapshot Networks
parameter.description: Networks that may fetch the snapshot URLs, as comma separated CIDR blocks. Defaults to loopback and the private ranges, so images stay in the local network even if a link leaks.

thing-type.label: Bosch Smart Home Camera
thing-type.description: A Bosch Smart Home Camera (Eyes outdoor camera, 360° indoor camera).

parameter.name: cameraId
parameter.label: Camera ID
parameter.description: ID of the camera as used by the Bosch cloud.

parameter.name: mqttBroker
parameter.label: MQTT Broker
parameter.description: Broker the camera publishes its events to, as a URI, e.g. mqtt://10.0.0.5:1883. Leave empty to leave the camera alone. Writing this to the camera changes its configuration.

parameter.name: mqttUser
parameter.label: MQTT User
parameter.description: User the camera logs in to the broker with.

parameter.name: mqttPassword
parameter.label: MQTT Password
parameter.description: Password the camera logs in to the broker with.

parameter.name: mqttTopicPrefix
parameter.label: MQTT Topic Prefix
parameter.description: Prefix the camera puts in front of the topics it publishes.

parameter.name: snapshotCacheSeconds
parameter.label: Snapshot Cache
parameter.description: How long a fetched image is reused before the camera is asked again. The number of viewers does not matter, they all share it.

channel-type.label: Privacy Mode
channel-type.description: ON switches the camera off, the 360° indoor camera closes its shutter.

channel-type.label: Notifications
channel-type.description: Push notifications of this camera to the Bosch app.

channel-type.label: Snapshot URL
channel-type.description: Address a still image of this camera can be fetched from. Contains a token, so treat it as a secret.

channel-type.label: Notifications Status
channel-type.description: Notification setting as the cloud reports it, e.g. FOLLOW_CAMERA_SCHEDULE or ALWAYS_OFF.

channel-type.label: Connection Status
channel-type.description: Connection state the Bosch cloud reports for this camera.
